title: The Missing Snack
story_text:
Lara brought cookies to school.
At break time, she opened her bag.
Her cookies were gone.
She looked around and saw crumbs on her desk.
Her friend Ben said sorry and shared his food.

title: The Rainy Trip
story_text:
Mika planned to go to the park.
But dark clouds filled the sky.
Soon, heavy rain began to fall.
Instead, she stayed home and played board games.
She still had fun with her family.

title: The Late Arrival
story_text:
Jon woke up late for school.
He rushed to get ready quickly.
He forgot his homework on the table.
At school, he felt worried.
His teacher told him to be more careful next time.

title: The Helpful Neighbor
story_text:
Anna saw her neighbor carrying heavy bags.
She offered to help without being asked.
Together, they brought the bags inside.
The neighbor smiled and thanked her.
Anna felt happy for helping.

title: The Broken Vase
story_text:
Leo was playing inside the house.
He hit a ball and broke a vase.
He felt scared and wanted to hide.
But he told the truth to his mother.
She thanked him for being honest.

title: The New Game
story_text:
Carlos found a new game at home.
At first, he did not understand the rules.
He tried again and read the instructions.
Soon, he learned how to play well.
He invited his sister to join him.

title: The Lost Puppy
story_text:
A puppy wandered away from home.
It walked through the streets alone.
A kind girl saw it and brought it to safety.
She looked for the owner and found them.
The puppy returned home happily.

title: The Group Project
story_text:
The class worked on a group project.
Each student had a task to do.
Some worked fast, others needed help.
They helped each other finish on time.
Their teacher praised their teamwork.

title: The Early Practice
story_text:
Mina wanted to be good at singing.
She practiced every morning before school.
At first, her voice was not strong.
But after many days, she improved a lot.
She felt proud of her progress.

title: The Stormy Night
story_text:
A loud storm came during the night.
Thunder and lightning scared Paul.
He stayed close to his parents.
They told him he was safe.
Soon, he felt calm again.

title: The Forgotten Plant
story_text:
Ella forgot to water her plant.
After a few days, the leaves turned dry.
She felt sad and worried.
She started watering it every day.
Slowly, the plant became green again.

title: The Library Visit
story_text:
The class visited the library.
They learned how to borrow books.
Tom chose a story about space.
He read it quietly at home.
He learned many new things.

title: The Clean Playground
story_text:
After playing, the children saw trash on the ground.
They decided to clean the playground.
They picked up bottles and papers.
Soon, the place looked neat again.
They felt proud of their work.

title: The Small Gift
story_text:
Nico had only a small gift for his friend.
He worried it was not enough.
But his friend smiled and thanked him.
The gift showed his care and kindness.
Nico felt happy and relieved.

title: The Long Wait
story_text:
Sofia planted a flower seed.
She waited many days to see it grow.
At first, nothing happened.
She kept watering it patiently.
Finally, a small plant appeared.
